messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for SLO burn on /v1/generate (eu-west).
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty Incident PD-9876 created — severity: P1 — link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-9876
Ben: acked PD-9876 and paging rotation. I'm pulling traces now.
Maya: I'm oncall2, joining. Quick stats from influx: p95 ~ 2.1s, p99 ~ 5.2s (baseline p99 is 1.1s). Token serving throughput dropped ~30% in last 3m.
Carlos: checking autoscaler events — saw several scale-downs at 03:14UTC then a bunch of coldstarts. Could be scale policy overshoot.
Dana: customer impact flag: some enterprise customers in eu-west reported timeouts >10s. I've opened a short customer note draft for CS to send if needed.
Ben: stack traces show prolonged KV cache miss ratio spike — redis pool exhaustion in inference-kv-eu. Happening right as a big retry storm from client sdk spiked.
Maya: copying relevant logs:
```
[2026-03-14T03:16:12Z] INF request_id=abc123 status=queued kv_cache.miss=true redis.err=timeout
[2026-03-14T03:16:13Z] ERR request_id=abc124 token_gen=delayed backend_latency=4200ms
```
Carlos: running quick check on redis connections:
```
kubectl -n infra exec redis-0 -- redis-cli info clients | grep connected_clients
connected_clients: 1024
```
Dana: redis maxclients at 1024 on that node — we're hitting the ceiling. Possibly due to connection leak or too many concurrent prefills.
Ben: mitigation proposal:
- temporarily route new requests to eu-central region (if acceptable)
- increase redis maxclients / add read replica
- enable model-fallback to quantized-1b for non-enterprise routes to reduce per-token work
- apply short rate-limit per-token to damp retry storms
Maya: I'm going to flip the circuit to fallback mode for non-SLA routes: 1) enable fallback policy, 2) ramp routing weight 30% to eu-central.
Carlos: I'll scale up the redis cluster and bump maxclients, doing a rolling restart to clear leaked connections. Taking action now: `infra/redis/scale --replicas 2 -> 3`.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollout: redis-eu scale up job started by Carlos (job id: scale-6681).
Ben: while redis scales, enable model variant fallback. Maya, what's the CLI for routing change?
Maya: Command:
```
redwoodctl route update /v1/generate --region eu-west --fallback-model redwood/quant-1b:latest --weight-fallback 0.3
```
Dana: CS notified for impacted customers; added a short status blurb to status.redwood.ai. Also opened PD incident notes: "temp fallback and redis scale underway".
Carlos: redis replica added, maxclients bumped to 4096, connection counts dropping. Observability: p99 trending down from 5.2s -> 2.6s.
Ben: good. Keep an eye on error budget burn. If p99 doesn't drop below 1.5s in 10m we'll escalate to infra-oncall for capacity increase.
Maya: p99 now 1.8s, p95 1.0s. Still above target but improving. Any deploys in last 30m?
deploy-bot: Recent deploys: inference-runtime v3.14.2 at 02:58UTC (no regressions flagged). No rollback.
Dana: I'm going to open a follow-up ticket to investigate the client SDK retry behavior and add defensive connection pooling in the gateway.
Ben: acknowledging handoff timeline — I'll stay until p99 < 1.2s for 15m. If it stabilizes, I'll run a controlled revert of the fallback after redis fully healthy.
Maya: noted. Keeping dashboard shared: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/p99-latency
Carlos: post-mortem tasks prefilled: investigate redis leak vs connection pattern, adjust autoscaler cooldowns to avoid thrash, add health probe for kv cache saturations.
Ben: thanks all. PD-9876 updated with mitigation steps and owner list. If anyone sees anomalous error spikes, ping here and escalate.
Maya: leaving a checklist for oncall rotation: 1) Verify redis client counts < 80% of max, 2) p99 < 1.2s for 15m, 3) rollback fallback if safe.
Dana: CS will wait for Ben confirm before sending final customer memo.
Ben: condition met at 03:29UTC — p99 = 1.05s, p95 = 0.9s, redis connections stabilized. I'm closing active mitigation but keeping PD incident open for postmortem.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-9876 acknowledged by Ben and marked mitigation in progress.
pagerduty-bot: PD-9876 note: Incident status: monitoring. Escalation not required.
Ben: handing off to next oncall; I'll add detailed notes in the PD ticket. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maya: great job, closing Slack thread once PD updated.
Dana: moving to post-incident review.
